suggestions.pitch: At 3-6 with a low contention window, selling the 37-year-old Kelce and an aging LB for young QB Stroud is a 0.70-likelihood rebuild move.
Love and Okonkwo for Stroud and DJ Moore costs the fewest points of the bigger offers while getting a younger QB back.
Love and Hunt for Waller and Kincaid is a modest-cost deal that the partner should accept at 0.64.
